allowedSourceMaterial.overview: The story centers around a graduating class of "less-gifted" students in a private Versailles high school. Only a miracle has brought the students this far along, and after a practical joke misfires and the whole school is dynamited, the students are in deep trouble. They have to present themselves in court for their punishment and it could not be worse: If they don't pass their high-school graduation exams, they go to prison!

semanticBoundaryFlags.message: The packet provides no explicit novelty or experimentation cues; familiar is inferred only from the conventional school-comedy premise and should be human-reviewed.
The dynamited school and prison stakes are comic hyperbole; suspenseful and exciting were considered and rejected in favor of funny alone.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With zero study habits and prison awaiting them if they fail, how will these hopeless students survive their final exams?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: At a private Versailles school, a class of struggling underachievers accidentally dynamites the building during a prank. Hauled into court, they face an ultimatum: pass their graduation exams or go to prison.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, fast-moving school farce that makes for a low-demand, laugh-out-loud watch with friends.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Claude Zidi delivers an undemanding French farce packed with broad laughs and escalating absurdity, turning high-school scholastic desperation into a breezy comic romp.
